label: Every lack fact of an actual root has an admitted reason
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every actual concrete root r at w and every determination d, if the arena's fact lack r d holds at w, then some fact is admitted at w as a reason for it (EXPLAINED_ABSENCE_1). It is the unrestricted fact PSR restricted to the lack facts of actual roots: a PSR for the closure of a necessary root's profile, not restricted to contingent facts. What lack r d is the fact of is fixed by the separate lack-facts premise. The #756 inquiry bridges, the contingent-fact PSR and the contingent-scoped quality conditions all hold in an arena where no root lack has a reason and this fails (InquiryScopeMap clause 11); it holds whenever the contingent-fact PSR does, with the necessary truths admitted as reasons for the necessary truths (clause 3).
